title: Haayre nde ñaami
intro: Haala ɓurka ɓooyde e kala laamu walla binndol—musiiba aadee gadano jibinaaɗo e kaaɗdi. Ruuhu gooto, mawɗo sukaaɓe ɗiɗo jibinaaɓe e jibnaaɓe adanɓe, ina ndaara e nder tikkere no miñi mum tokooso heɓirta moƴƴere nde yeddaaka. Ko rewi heen ko cuɓagol ɓurngol niɓɓiɗde, acci ƴiiƴam gadanal ɗam meeɗaa rufde e dow leydi. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo, ñaawoore ndee, e nimsa mettuɗo oo ?
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e yimɓe ɗiɗo adanɓe yahde e dow leydi.
Mi meeɗii waɗde Alla sadaka, kono ɗum jaɓaaka e am.
Sadaka miñi am jaɓaama, am jaɓaaka — huunde nde mi waawaa muñde.
Mi hulɓinii miñi am e halkaare.
Miin woni gadano waɗde warngo e dow oo aduna, ƴettude nguurndam miñi am.
Alla neldi tagoore leydi – colli ɓaleeji ina njuppa e leydi – ngam jannginde mi no suuɗirta ko mbaɗmi koo, mi heddoraaki hay huunde so wonaa nimsa.

outcome.answer: Wonti heewde nimsa e nder majjuɓe

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
